reviews.title: SO. MUCH. AI.
reviews.text: The AI in this app is so bad and so abundant, it’s actually distracting 😭

reviews.title: no thanks
reviews.text: there’s nothing spiritual about using generative AI

reviews.title: They use AI
reviews.text: I was really excited when I saw an ad for this app because the premise seemed interesting. To my disappointment upon downloading the app, I saw that all the art used was AI. AI has absolutely no place in spirituality. I would be happy to revisit if they renounce AI and hire actual artists or graphic designers. Deeply disappointed in the app developers laziness and greed, which again has absolutely NO place in an individual’s spiritual practice.

reviews.title: contains AI slop
reviews.text: saw an ad for it on IG, thought it looked cool, but as soon as i saw all the AI images i got major ick and deleted.

reviews.title: AI SLOP. DO NOT USE
reviews.text: This app charges way too much for in app purchases, and it’s full of AI

reviews.title: Heavily paywalled
reviews.text: Seems to have potential but almost everything being paywalled is frustrating. Much of it is not labeled as paywalled, either. It seems heavily bent toward making as much money as possible, too, because it has a ‘shop’ section with crazy expensive classes or lessons or whatever the heck they all are. It’s a shame because the app seems neat on the outset but I’m not sure I’d even subscribe at this point.

reviews.title: Don’t install, paywalled
reviews.text: Every feature of this app is behind a paywall. Don’t waste your time.

reviews.title: Use to love
reviews.text: The one thing I liked about this app is while you didn’t get access to everything, unless you had a subscription, you still got access to a decent amount. So much so I decided to get a subscription. But after some unforeseeable and unavoidable life changes, I had to cancel the subscription. I got into the app (after a long while of not being on it) only to find, that a lot of what you had access to without a subscription, you no longer get access to. Very disappointing, and I’m sorry but if something doesn’t have a lock on it, that usually means it’s accessible without subscription, but when I tried to do it, the stupid subscribe to access pay wall popped up. Misleading and not truly available without a subscription. I get that money is how apps keep running and such. But at this rate it’s become another app that you basically can do 1-2 things on it without a subscription. And if you can afford to pay the either subscription cost (monthly or yearly) your SOL. Disappointed. I really loved this app. But looks like it’s another app I have to say goodbye too.

reviews.text: Can’t see the updated live classes just the old ones :(

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: This app doesn’t work for me. Every day it sends me a prompt at 11:11. I click and nothing happens.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Really expensive for what you get, always freezes and they’re always trying to sell you more BS. The card pulls are often the same card repeatedly, I wish I had cancelled it before I was auto charged the high yearly cost, not worth it at all, also childish interface.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: App lags like nothing, I have to constantly shut it and reopen it because it gets stuck (this is not my phone or internet connection because it’s only on this app) and it’s RIDDLED with AI. I don’t think the free trial is even worth the hassle.

reviews.title: Cool, but….
reviews.text: The app is cool but the use of AI completely turned me off. I uninstalled, but I would love to find an app similar to this one with no AI. Because that’s honestly the only issue.

reviews.title: Total disappointment
reviews.text: I am so completely disappointed in this app. It feels like it was a data mining expedition. I tried to set it up and login via my Apple account, Facebook, and an email. Each time I just got the spinning circle of it processing, but never actually doing anything. It had mixed reviews, but I figured I would give it a shot. If it won’t even Load enough to be able to try and check it out it’s not worth my time

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I bought a subscription and it won’t let me login! The bar just keeps spinning and will not load.

reviews.title: Bombarded with Marketing
reviews.text: The spiritual aspects in no way out way how many texts, notifications and emails they send to sell you things. I’m talking many times a day EVERY day.

reviews.title: Money hungry
reviews.text: I understand apps have to make money but i would rather see ads than have every single feature locked behind premium. I can’t even draw a tarot card without premium. I downloaded the app and now im immediately deleting it because all it does is ask for money every 5 seconds to use a single feature. This isn’t how you get new users or build your business. This is actually how you slowly kill your business.

reviews.title: I need assistance
reviews.text: I attempted to take advantage of a $49.99 offer in January.  My card was charged but I am unable to get to a sign in screen that would enable me with moving forward in the creation of my account.  I have attempted to contact the Sage Admin but I have yet to receive a response. It’s been well over a month.

reviews.title: Constant pop ups to go premium
reviews.text: Not enjoyable to use this app unless you pay for it because every couple of seconds you get a pop-up suggesting you pay for premium. Same advertisement to go premium every time you log on.

reviews.title: I like the concept, but everything is AI slop
reviews.text: Bonus star for the concept. Literally everything is AI generated slop. This was almost what I was looking for as a beginning practitioner, but all of the images and I’m sure a lot of the text is just… AI. Disappointing. Wanted to love it!

reviews.title: Filled with AI art & laggy
reviews.text: This app feels cheep, especially for $12.99 a month. The UI is strange and it feels like a cash grab (especially since there’s a button for their shop smack dab in the navigation bar). The app freezes up and lags between screens sometimes. It also is filled with AI art.

reviews.title: Charged for free trial
reviews.text: I clicked the enabled free trial but then my account was immediately charged $75. It also doesn’t let me log in. I’ve tried deleting the app and reinstalling. I want my money back.

reviews.title: Charged 3 times!
reviews.text: This app charged my card twice and then charged a 2nd card. No customer service or help to correct it. Be careful!

reviews.title: Soulless AI money grab
reviews.text: To keep in short, this app is everything wrong with capitalism and corporate greed wrapped up in fanciful AI art packaging. AI is not a reliable source of information and causes far too much damage to the environment to justify using it for something so frivolous. On top of that the app promotes using rituals that are sacred to certain cultures without providing context.
